summary: Body-width geometry, calibration handling, legacy-field preservation, representative-plane selection, tracking reconciliation, and report field selection are supported by implementation, focused synthetic/adversarial tests, and retained RC6 evidence. RC6 report-path and count blockers are resolved in the reviewed evidence.

limitations: The retained report package documents deterministic replay from frozen 2D detections; audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json:23 states U-Net inference was not rerun.
Body width remains apparent segmented-mask width and is not PSF-corrected physical chromatin width, as recorded in audits/claims_registry.json:55-59.

The evidence represents one specimen per group and therefore does not establish a biological KJ-versus-WT effect; audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:5-14 records the inference limitation.
recommended_follow_up: Retain this review as the measurement_geometry output for the RC7 audit run and complete the remaining independent role reviews before production acceptance.
